title: Matheran Monsoon Escape
description: Experience India's only automobile-free hill station with misty forest trails, panoramic viewpoints, toy train rides and peaceful monsoon landscapes.
inclusions: Campfire Experience (Subject to weather and local permissions)
Dedicated Trip Coordinator Throughout the Journey
exclusions: Airfare, Train tickets, and Visa fees
Entry tickets to monuments, museums, or parks
Personal expenses, tips, laundry, and optional adventure activities

itinerary.title: Journey Begins
itinerary.desc: Board your sleeper train to Panvel and begin an exciting adventure to the charming hill station of Matheran. Relax during the overnight journey and get ready for an unforgettable weekend surrounded by nature.

itinerary.title: Explore the Beauty of Matheran
itinerary.desc: Arrive in Matheran and check in to your hotel. Spend the day exploring scenic trekking trails, lush forests, panoramic viewpoints, and popular attractions. Enjoy delicious local meals and soak in the peaceful atmosphere of this vehicle-free hill station.

itinerary.title: Heritage Toy Train & Return Journey
itinerary.desc: After breakfast and hotel check-out, experience the iconic Matheran Toy Train, a UNESCO-recognized heritage attraction. Enjoy a short scenic walk before traveling back to Panvel by taxi to board your return train.

itinerary.title: Arrive Home
itinerary.desc: Reach home with unforgettable memories, beautiful photographs, and stories from an incredible Matheran adventure.
